faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Mizoram Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIT Mizoram JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the NIT Mizoram recruitment drive. This offers a specific opportunity for eligible candidates in the relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 28 years. Age relaxation benefits are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms, up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/women/PH candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the JRF post at NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master degree (M.Tech/M.E/M.Sc.) in relevant fields like Computer Science & Engineering, IT, ECE, Mechanical, Aerospace, Mathematics, Robotics, AI, ML, Data Science with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CPI/CGPA in both M.Tech/M.E/M.Sc. and B.Tech/B.E/B.Sc.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow (JRF) will receive a salary of INR 37,000/- per month plus HRA. This is a competitive stipend for research positions in government institutions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NIT Mizoram JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Mizoram Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position at NIT Mizoram?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Mizoram involves two main stages: shortlisting of eligible candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the NIT Mizoram Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of NIT Mizoram. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading necessary documents, and submitting it before the last date, 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for NIT Mizoram recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for applying and getting more information about NIT Mizoram recruitment is https://www.nitmz.ac.in. All official notifications and application links will be available on this portal.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Mizoram is a contractual job type. It is typically for a specific project duration, offering valuable research experience in a government institution.
